description: Runs Maka sessions and child agents through a user-installed local Codex app-server.

codexPath.title: Codex executable
codexPath.description: Command name or absolute path for the user-installed Codex CLI.

model.title: Codex model fallback
model.description: Used when a Maka Session has no selected model. Leave empty to use the local Codex default.

sandbox.title: Sandbox mode
sandbox.description: Codex runs unattended with approvalPolicy=never, so read-only is the safe default.

inheritEnvironmentCredentials.title: Inherit credential environment variables
inheritEnvironmentCredentials.description: Native Codex login files remain available when this is disabled.
